claims.text: Under POL-NS-01(a) a no-show fee is chargeable only where the trip_record contains a driver 'arrived' event for the trip. EV-TRIP-00615 records arrived_at as null and started_at as null: the platform logged no arrival at all. Limb (a) fails, so the fee is not chargeable under the anchor clause and the refund question falls to be decided under POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 or POL-NS-06 as applicable.

Under POL-NS-02 the driver is deemed to have arrived only where the trace contains at least 3 consecutive fixes within the arrival radius of the pickup pin, which fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m fixes at 50 m for a STANDARD zone. EV-GPS-00615 shows the driver's CLOSEST approach to the pin was 2,919.5 m, with 0 qualifying in-radius fixes out of 73 driver fixes across 100% coverage. Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 fails, and where there is no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes preceding cancellation POL-NS-02 entitles the rider to a full refund.

POL-NS-01(c) requires a continuous dwell inside the pickup geofence of at least 300 seconds for a STANDARD pickup, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix. The derived arrival block on EV-GPS-00615 reports a longest qualifying run of 0 fixes and 0.0 seconds, a shortfall of 300.0 seconds. Limb (c) therefore fails on the same trace that defeats limb (b).

POL-NS-01(d) requires the trip to be terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. EV-TRIP-00615 records cancelled_by RIDER and cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, which is not one of the three recognised codes, and the driver's own message on EV-CHAT-00615 — 'not coming, cancel yourself' — shows the rider cancelled only because the driver refused to cancel himself and thereby accept the penalty. Limb (d) fails.

POL-NS-06 makes the cancellation fee unchargeable where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the zone minimum, and it says so expressly whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. The measured dwell is 0 seconds against the 300 seconds required for STANDARD, so the SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line itemised in EV-FARE-00615 must be refunded to the rider in full.

POL-NS-03 does not rescue this fee. It applies only where the trace shows the driver stationary for the required dwell outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pickup pin. The driver's closest recorded position was 2,919.5 m away — more than seven times the 400 m ceiling — so the wrong-entrance clause is not engaged and neither limb (i) nor limb (ii) of POL-NS-03 can be reached.

POL-NS-06(i) permits in-geofence intervals to be summed across a pickup attempt only where a traffic_advisory whose geometry covers the pickup road is present and populated. EV-ADVIS-00615-01 is MISSING: it has no payload and carries weight 0.0, meaning no advisory covers this pickup road in this window. Limb (i) is therefore unavailable, and in any event there are 0 in-geofence intervals to accumulate. Under POL-GEN-02 the absence of the artifact is itself citable and the artifact can carry no fact.

There is no evidentiary basis for escalation on this record. The trace is complete (coverage_pct 100.0, max_gap_sec 0.0, 73 fixes at the expected 10 s cadence), the chat log's one message matches trip_record.chat_message_count of 1, and the SGD 6.00 charged in EV-FARE-00615 equals the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule. No limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08 is engaged, so no artifact is down-weighted and confidence in a full refund is not capped.

POL-NS-07 driver compensation is not engaged. That clause applies only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it', and all four limbs of POL-NS-01 fail on this record while POL-NS-06 displaces the fee outright. No compensation is payable and the rider's SGD 6.00 must come back.

The rider was at the pickup point, not absent from it. The derived rider_presence block on EV-GPS-00615 records 54 fixes, every one of them qualifying, at a mean distance of 10.6 m and a maximum of 14.6 m from the pin — far inside the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m. POL-NS-06 refunds the fee whether or not the rider was present; here she plainly was, so no residual rider-absence argument can save the charge.

The driver's own conduct and words establish that the pickup was abandoned on the driver's side. EV-CHAT-00615 records a single message, sent by the DRIVER at 06:00:40 and read at 06:01:10, reading 'not coming, cancel yourself', and his counterparty statement admits 'A better job came up and I took it.' An admission that he was not coming cannot satisfy POL-NS-01(d), which requires a driver termination for a rider-side reason code.

In the alternative, to the extent any arrival marker is read into this record at all, POL-NS-05(ii) directs that where no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip the cancellation fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip is recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver in the ruling's referrals list. EV-GPS-00615 reports 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes across the whole trip, so that limb returns the whole SGD 6.00 to the rider.

claims.text: The platform's own termination record puts the end of this trip in the rider's hands, not my client's: EV-TRIP-00615 records cancelled_by 'RIDER', status 'CANCELLED_BY_RIDER' and cancellation_reason_code 'RIDER_CHANGED_MIND', and it carries none of the driver-side codes POL-NS-01(d) names — RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE and EXCESSIVE_WAIT are all absent. The driver never tapped 'arrived' and never booked this ride out as a rider no-show; the SGD 6.00 line in EV-FARE-00615 was raised on the rider's own cancellation.

There is no false-arrival case to answer. POL-NS-05 runs only off an 'arrived' event in the trip record, and EV-TRIP-00615 has none — arrived_at is null, as is the arrival fact derived from EV-GPS-00615 — so the clause has no marker to match against a GPS fix and the false-arrival referral POL-NS-05(ii) directs into the ruling is not available against this driver.

POL-NS-04 cannot be run against my client on either limb. Limb (a) requires a rider chat message that is locating or coordinating; EV-CHAT-00615 holds exactly one message and it is the driver's own, sent at 06:00:40 by sender 'DRIVER', so no rider message of any kind exists. Limb (b) requires that the driver neither replied in chat within 120 seconds nor placed an in-app call before terminating; EV-TRIP-00615.in_app_calls records an answered 30-second in-app call placed by the driver at 05:51:40, eleven minutes before the 06:02:40 termination. No finding that my client left the rider's contact unanswered is open on this record.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip on this driver, so there is no profile-based abuse finding against him and no profile-based withholding of driver money on this record. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, short of the '4 or more' limb, and 3 divided by completed_trips_30d of 88 is 0.034, short of the 0.08 rate limb; the clause requires BOTH limbs, and I cite those two fields only, as POL-GEN-01 permits for exactly this test.

I do not stretch the trace, and I do not ask the judge to. EV-GPS-00615's driver track never comes nearer than 2,919.55 m to the pickup pin; its arrival analysis returns 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds, and EV-TRIP-00615.arrived_at is null. The driver accepts that POL-NS-01 limbs (a), (b) and (c) are not made out on this record and does not contend otherwise; the fee question follows that arithmetic, and what the record does not support is any adverse finding against the driver beyond it.

EV-ADVIS-00615-01 is MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0 — no traffic advisory covers the pickup road in this window. My client asserts nothing from it: with run_count 0 there is no second in-geofence interval for POL-NS-06(i) to accumulate and no present advisory to license accumulation, so the driver does not put a zero-weight artifact forward as an excuse for not arriving, and none of his case rests on it.

ruling.explanation: Both sides' central claims are accepted, and they point the same way: the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee cannot stand. The anchor clause POL-NS-01 requires all four conditions, and each one fails. (a) The trip record (EV-TRIP-00615) has arrived_at null and started_at null — the platform logged no driver 'arrived' event at all. (b) The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00615) never puts the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius; his closest approach was 2,919.5 m, with 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes out of 73. (c) The longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum — a 300-second shortfall. (d) The trip was cancelled by the rider with reason code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, which is not one of the three driver-side codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises. With no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes before cancellation, POL-NS-02 entitles the rider to a full refund, and POL-NS-06 confirms it: a 0-second dwell against a 300-second minimum makes the cancellation fee unchargeable whether or not the rider was present. The rider's own device (EV-GPS-00615 rider_presence, 54 fixes, mean 10.6 m, maximum 14.6 m, all inside the 100 m STANDARD radius) shows she was at the pickup throughout. POL-NS-03 does not rescue the fee — its 400 m ceiling is not met, since the driver was never stationary at 2,919.5 m — so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. The driver's own in-app message, 'not coming, cancel yourself' (EV-CHAT-00615, sent 06:00:40), and his statement that 'a better job came up and I took it' are accepted as admissions that the pickup was abandoned on the driver's side; they reinforce the failure of limb (d) and foreclose any rider no-show finding. On the driver's side, POL-NS-07 compensation is not engaged because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full; the anti-farming check does not trip either — no_show_terminations_30d is 3 (below the '4 or more' limb) and 3 divided by 88 completed_trips_30d is 0.034 (below the 0.08 rate limb) — so no driver compensation is withheld or payable. Escalation is not engaged: the trace is complete (100% coverage, 0-second maximum gap, 73 fixes at the expected 10 s cadence), the chat log's single message matches trip_record.chat_message_count of 1, and the SGD 6.00 charged reconciles with the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule — so no POL-NS-08 limb (a) to (d) fires and no POL-NS-09 trigger applies. No false-arrival referral arises under POL-NS-05(ii): that clause runs only off a trip-record 'arrived' event, and this trip has none, so there is no marker to record against the driver. EV-ADVIS-00615-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0; it carries no fact, and no part of this ruling rests on it. Result: the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, with no driver compensation.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: I have found for you. The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee charged on EV-FARE-00615 (cancellation_fee line = SGD 6.00, payment_status CHARGED, charged at 06:03:00) must be refunded to you in full.

To the driver: the fee is not chargeable against this rider, and I explain why in figures you can check.

POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only if all four limbs hold, and none of them does. (a) EV-TRIP-00615 has arrived_at null and started_at null: no driver 'arrived' event was ever logged. (b) EV-GPS-00615 places your closest approach to the pickup pin at 2,919.5 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), against an arrival radius of 50 m for a STANDARD pickup, with 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes out of 73. (c) The longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0 fixes and 0.0 seconds, a shortfall of 300.0 s against the 300 s STANDARD minimum. (d) EV-TRIP-00615 records cancelled_by 'RIDER' with cancellation_reason_code 'RIDER_CHANGED_MIND', not one of the three driver-side codes POL-NS-01(d) names. With all four limbs failing, the anchor clause does not make the fee chargeable, and the refund follows under POL-NS-02 (no qualifying in-radius fix anywhere in the 15 minutes before cancellation) and again under POL-NS-06 (effective dwell 0 s against 300 s). Those two clauses both license FULL_REFUND and both point the same way.

On the points argued:
- POL-NS-03 is not engaged: it requires the driver stationary for the dwell within 400 m of the pin, and your nearest recorded position was 2,919.5 m away, more than seven times that ceiling. No wrong-entrance or pin-ambiguity goodwill arises, and registered_pickup_points is 1 in any event.
- POL-NS-07 driver compensation is not payable. That clause runs only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; neither condition holds. I note the anti-farming check does not trip either (no_show_terminations_30d 3, below 4; 3/88 = 0.034, below 0.08), but the compensation question is already answered by the failed anchor clause.
- POL-NS-04 does not need to be run. The chat log holds one message and it is the driver's own, and the trip record shows an answered 30-second in-app call placed by the driver at 05:51:40, so no 'unanswered rider contact' finding is open against the driver.
- POL-NS-05 does not fire, and the rider's alternative request for a POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival referral is rejected. That clause operates only where an 'arrived' event exists and the trace contradicts it. Here no arrival marker was ever set, so there is no false marker to record and the referral in POL-NS-05(ii) is unavailable. Nothing is entered against you on that footing.
- Your counterparty statement concedes that a better job came up and you took it. That is an admission against your own interest and it confirms the pickup was abandoned, but it is not needed to decide the fee; the GPS arithmetic alone does it.
- The rider's presence evidence (54 qualifying fixes at a mean of 10.6 m from the pin) is accepted, though POL-NS-06 refunds the fee whether or not the rider was present.

On escalation: no limb of POL-NS-09 is engaged. The trace is complete (coverage 100%, max gap 0.0 s, 73 fixes at the 10 s cadence), the chat log matches chat_message_count of 1, and the SGD 6.00 charged equals the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, so POL-NS-08(a)-(d) is not met. The counterparty counters are both zero. No artifact is down-weighted, and my confidence rests on the GPS trace and trip record at full weight 1.0, above the 0.70 floor. The one claim discarded on the rider's side (the POL-NS-06(i) advisory point) was discarded on the referee's mechanical check, not on the merits, and nothing in this ruling depends on it.

No referral is produced by any clause, so the referrals list is empty.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee charged to the rider is refunded in full.

A no-show fee can stand only if all four conditions of POL-NS-01 hold, and each of them fails on this record. (a) The trip record (EV-TRIP-00615) contains no driver 'arrived' event — arrived_at and started_at are both null. (b) The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00615) never places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius of the pickup pin: across 73 driver fixes at 100% coverage his closest approach was 2,919.5 m, with 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes. (c) The required dwell for a STANDARD pickup is 300 seconds and the measured longest qualifying run is 0.0 seconds. (d) The record shows the trip terminated with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, which is none of the three driver-side codes the limb names. With all four limbs failing, the fee is not chargeable, and both POL-NS-02 (no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes before cancellation) and POL-NS-06 (dwell shorter than the zone minimum) direct a full refund of the cancellation-fee line: SGD 6.00. That figure is the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, and it reconciles with the charged line, so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises.

No driver money is owed. POL-NS-03 (wrong-entrance) is not engaged: the driver was never within the 400 m ceiling of the pin, let alone stationary there for the dwell, so neither the driver-bears-loss limb nor the POL-NS-03(ii) pin-ambiguity goodwill payment is available. POL-NS-07 compensation requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full and it is not, so driver_compensation_sgd is null. The driver's own anti-farming point is accepted: no_show_terminations_30d of 3 is short of 4 and 3/88 = 0.034 is short of 0.08, and those are the only two fields POL-GEN-01 permits for that test.

On the rider's alternative argument for a false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii): the whole of POL-NS-05 runs off an 'arrived' event in the trip record, and there is none anywhere on this record. There is therefore no false arrival to record, no referral fires, and that claim is rejected.

The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00615-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0. Its absence is itself citable, it can carry no fact, and nothing in this ruling rests on it; its only consequence is that POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable, which is irrelevant where there are 0 in-geofence intervals to sum.

No escalation trigger applies under POL-NS-09. Confidence is not capped below 1.0: the deciding facts — that the driver never arrived and never held the required dwell — are carried by EV-GPS-00615 and EV-TRIP-00615, both at weight 1.0, and the trace is complete (100% coverage, 0 s maximum gap, 73 fixes at the expected 10 s cadence), the chat log's single message matches the trip record's chat_message_count of 1, and the fee reconciles with the fee schedule.

The driver's conduct point the rider raised — the chat message 'not coming, cancel yourself' and the driver's own statement 'A better job came up and I took it' — is accepted as an admission against the driver's interest, but it does not change the money outcome; the refund follows from the arrival arithmetic alone.

ruling.explanation:
The SGD 6.00 no-show fee charged to the rider is refunded in full.

Under POL-NS-01 a cancellation fee stands only if all four conditions hold, and on this record none does. (a) EV-TRIP-00615 shows arrived_at as null — the platform logged no driver arrival event. (b) EV-GPS-00615 places the driver's closest approach at 2,919.5 m from the pickup pin, with 0 of 73 fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, so POL-NS-02's proximity test is not met; POL-NS-02 states that where no qualifying in-radius fix exists in the 15 minutes before cancellation the rider is entitled to a full refund. (c) The required dwell for a STANDARD pickup is 300 seconds; the measured in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds, a shortfall of 300 seconds, which under POL-NS-06 makes the fee unchargeable whether or not the rider was present — and EV-GPS-00615's rider track in fact places her 10.6 m on average from the pin, well inside the 100 m radius. (d) The trip was cancelled by the rider with reason code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, not terminated by the driver with any of the three driver-side codes POL-NS-01(d) names. The driver is right that the platform record puts the cancellation in the rider's hands — that is precisely why limb (d) fails. The driver's own in-app message 'not coming, cancel yourself' (EV-CHAT-00615) and his statement that a better job came up are consistent with this outcome.

Driver compensation: POL-NS-07 applies only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not, so no compensation is payable. The anti-farming check does not trip in any event (no_show_terminations_30d of 3 is below the threshold of 4, and 3/88 = 0.034 is below 0.08).

The driver's point that POL-NS-04 cannot be run against him is accepted, but it does not affect the fee: the refund is decided under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06, not POL-NS-04.

No false-arrival referral is issued. POL-NS-05 runs off an 'arrived' event in the trip record, and this trip has none, so the clause has no marker to read and POL-NS-05(ii) produces nothing.

No escalation. The trace is complete (100% coverage, 0 s max gap, 73 fixes at the expected 10 s cadence), the chat log's single message matches EV-TRIP-00615's chat_message_count of 1, and the SGD 6.00 charged equals the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, so no limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged and none of POL-NS-09's triggers fires. The refund rests on EV-GPS-00615 and EV-TRIP-00615, both at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is not capped; the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00615-01 (weight 0.0) carries no fact the ruling depends on.

ledger.claim: Under POL-NS-01(a) a no-show fee is chargeable only where the trip_record contains a driver 'arrived' event for the trip. EV-TRIP-00615 records arrived_at as null and started_at as null: the platform logged no arrival at all. Limb (a) fails, so the fee is not chargeable under the anchor clause and the refund question falls to be decided under POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 or POL-NS-06 as applicable.

Under POL-NS-02 the driver is deemed to have arrived only where the trace contains at least 3 consecutive fixes within the arrival radius of the pickup pin, which fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m fixes at 50 m for a STANDARD zone. EV-GPS-00615 shows the driver's CLOSEST approach to the pin was 2,919.5 m, with 0 qualifying in-radius fixes out of 73 driver fixes across 100% coverage. Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 fails, and where there is no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes preceding cancellation POL-NS-02 entitles the rider to a full refund.

POL-NS-01(c) requires a continuous dwell inside the pickup geofence of at least 300 seconds for a STANDARD pickup, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix. The derived arrival block on EV-GPS-00615 reports a longest qualifying run of 0 fixes and 0.0 seconds, a shortfall of 300.0 seconds. Limb (c) therefore fails on the same trace that defeats limb (b).

POL-NS-01(d) requires the trip to be terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. EV-TRIP-00615 records cancelled_by RIDER and cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, which is not one of the three recognised codes, and the driver's own message on EV-CHAT-00615 — 'not coming, cancel yourself' — shows the rider cancelled only because the driver refused to cancel himself and thereby accept the penalty. Limb (d) fails.

POL-NS-06 makes the cancellation fee unchargeable where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the zone minimum, and it says so expressly whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. The measured dwell is 0 seconds against the 300 seconds required for STANDARD, so the SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line itemised in EV-FARE-00615 must be refunded to the rider in full.

POL-NS-03 does not rescue this fee. It applies only where the trace shows the driver stationary for the required dwell outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pickup pin. The driver's closest recorded position was 2,919.5 m away — more than seven times the 400 m ceiling — so the wrong-entrance clause is not engaged and neither limb (i) nor limb (ii) of POL-NS-03 can be reached.

POL-NS-06(i) permits in-geofence intervals to be summed across a pickup attempt only where a traffic_advisory whose geometry covers the pickup road is present and populated. EV-ADVIS-00615-01 is MISSING: it has no payload and carries weight 0.0, meaning no advisory covers this pickup road in this window. Limb (i) is therefore unavailable, and in any event there are 0 in-geofence intervals to accumulate. Under POL-GEN-02 the absence of the artifact is itself citable and the artifact can carry no fact.

ledger.claim: There is no evidentiary basis for escalation on this record. The trace is complete (coverage_pct 100.0, max_gap_sec 0.0, 73 fixes at the expected 10 s cadence), the chat log's one message matches trip_record.chat_message_count of 1, and the SGD 6.00 charged in EV-FARE-00615 equals the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule. No limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08 is engaged, so no artifact is down-weighted and confidence in a full refund is not capped.

POL-NS-07 driver compensation is not engaged. That clause applies only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it', and all four limbs of POL-NS-01 fail on this record while POL-NS-06 displaces the fee outright. No compensation is payable and the rider's SGD 6.00 must come back.

The rider was at the pickup point, not absent from it. The derived rider_presence block on EV-GPS-00615 records 54 fixes, every one of them qualifying, at a mean distance of 10.6 m and a maximum of 14.6 m from the pin — far inside the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m. POL-NS-06 refunds the fee whether or not the rider was present; here she plainly was, so no residual rider-absence argument can save the charge.

The driver's own conduct and words establish that the pickup was abandoned on the driver's side. EV-CHAT-00615 records a single message, sent by the DRIVER at 06:00:40 and read at 06:01:10, reading 'not coming, cancel yourself', and his counterparty statement admits 'A better job came up and I took it.' An admission that he was not coming cannot satisfy POL-NS-01(d), which requires a driver termination for a rider-side reason code.

In the alternative, to the extent any arrival marker is read into this record at all, POL-NS-05(ii) directs that where no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip the cancellation fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip is recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver in the ruling's referrals list. EV-GPS-00615 reports 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes across the whole trip, so that limb returns the whole SGD 6.00 to the rider.

The platform's own termination record puts the end of this trip in the rider's hands, not my client's: EV-TRIP-00615 records cancelled_by 'RIDER', status 'CANCELLED_BY_RIDER' and cancellation_reason_code 'RIDER_CHANGED_MIND', and it carries none of the driver-side codes POL-NS-01(d) names — RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE and EXCESSIVE_WAIT are all absent. The driver never tapped 'arrived' and never booked this ride out as a rider no-show; the SGD 6.00 line in EV-FARE-00615 was raised on the rider's own cancellation.

There is no false-arrival case to answer. POL-NS-05 runs only off an 'arrived' event in the trip record, and EV-TRIP-00615 has none — arrived_at is null, as is the arrival fact derived from EV-GPS-00615 — so the clause has no marker to match against a GPS fix and the false-arrival referral POL-NS-05(ii) directs into the ruling is not available against this driver.

POL-NS-04 cannot be run against my client on either limb. Limb (a) requires a rider chat message that is locating or coordinating; EV-CHAT-00615 holds exactly one message and it is the driver's own, sent at 06:00:40 by sender 'DRIVER', so no rider message of any kind exists. Limb (b) requires that the driver neither replied in chat within 120 seconds nor placed an in-app call before terminating; EV-TRIP-00615.in_app_calls records an answered 30-second in-app call placed by the driver at 05:51:40, eleven minutes before the 06:02:40 termination. No finding that my client left the rider's contact unanswered is open on this record.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip on this driver, so there is no profile-based abuse finding against him and no profile-based withholding of driver money on this record. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, short of the '4 or more' limb, and 3 divided by completed_trips_30d of 88 is 0.034, short of the 0.08 rate limb; the clause requires BOTH limbs, and I cite those two fields only, as POL-GEN-01 permits for exactly this test.

I do not stretch the trace, and I do not ask the judge to. EV-GPS-00615's driver track never comes nearer than 2,919.55 m to the pickup pin; its arrival analysis returns 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds, and EV-TRIP-00615.arrived_at is null. The driver accepts that POL-NS-01 limbs (a), (b) and (c) are not made out on this record and does not contend otherwise; the fee question follows that arithmetic, and what the record does not support is any adverse finding against the driver beyond it.

EV-ADVIS-00615-01 is MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0 — no traffic advisory covers the pickup road in this window. My client asserts nothing from it: with run_count 0 there is no second in-geofence interval for POL-NS-06(i) to accumulate and no present advisory to license accumulation, so the driver does not put a zero-weight artifact forward as an excuse for not arriving, and none of his case rests on it.
